title: TRELLIS.2: image to textured 3D mesh
summary: One image in, a textured .glb mesh out: generation passes, mesh cleanup, UV unwrap and export.

steps.title: The source image
steps.body: The picture of the object to turn into 3D. A clean cut-out on a transparent or plain background gives the model the clearest signal.
steps.tryIt: Load an image of a single object.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Prepare the image
steps.body: Pads and resizes the image (padding 10, max size 1024). Background removal is switched off here, so the image should already be cut out.
steps.tryIt: Turn on remove_background if your image still has a background.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Load the 3D model
steps.body: Loads TRELLIS.2 4B. low_vram is on, which trades speed for fitting into smaller GPUs, and keep_models_loaded is off so memory is freed between stages.
steps.tryIt: Leave low_vram on for a 12 GB card.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Read the image
steps.body: Extracts features from the image that the next stages use as guidance.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Pass 1: rough structure
steps.body: Roughly decides where the object occupies space. 50 steps, guidance 7.5, heun sampler. The seed here changes the shape.
steps.tryIt: Change the seed to get a different shape.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Pass 2: shape
steps.body: Refines that structure into detailed geometry at 1024 resolution, 25 steps.
steps.tryIt: Lower shape_steps to trade detail for speed.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Pass 3: texture
steps.body: Generates the surface appearance for that shape: 25 steps.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Decode to a mesh
steps.body: Turns the generated latent data into an actual mesh with texture data. The tiled decoder lowers peak memory.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Clean the geometry
steps.body: Rebuilds the mesh with quad faces and removes floaters (stray bits) and inner faces.
steps.tryIt: Turn remove_floaters off to see what it was removing.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Reduce the polygon count
steps.body: Simplifies the mesh toward the Target Face Number (1,000,000 here) using the Cumesh method.
steps.tryIt: Lower the target and compare the mesh in the preview.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Unwrap and bake the texture
steps.body: Flattens the 3D surface into a 2D UV layout and bakes the texture onto it at 2048 by 2048. Gaps are filled by inpainting with the telea method.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Export
steps.body: Writes the finished mesh to disk as a .glb file, ready for Blender or a game engine.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Look at it in 3D
steps.body: Previews the exported mesh right here so you can orbit around it.
source: docs/reports/track_facts.md: Gen Textured Mesh with Trellis2.json

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: Queue Prompt sends the whole workflow to the GPU. Nodes light up as they run, and results appear in the Save node.
steps.tryIt: Press Ctrl+Enter, or the Queue button in the highlighted area.
